name: Auxiliary Vision Inspection Unit
summary: Through automatic flipping and image recognition, assist or replace manual labor in product appearance quality inspection. Solve the difficulty of manually flipping heavy products.
contentHtml:
The auxiliary visual inspection unit is an automated auxiliary equipment developed by TXAM for product quality inspection.

Working Principle

The equipment automatically flips the product and works with the image recognition system to assist in completing product appearance quality inspection. Effectively solves the difficulty of manually flipping heavy products.

Technical Advantages

  • Automatic flipping function, solving the difficulty of flipping heavy products
  • Works with the vision system to improve inspection accuracy
  • Significantly improves appearance inspection efficiency
  • Reduces employee labor intensity
